query: UPDATE playback_state SET position_seconds = COALESCE(?, position_seconds), duration_seconds = COALESCE(?, duration_seconds), playback_rate = COALESCE(?, playback_rate), volume = COALESCE(?, volume), is_audio_mode = COALESCE(?, is_audio_mode), is_pip = COALESCE(?, is_pip), current_instance_id = COALESCE(?, current_instance_id), last_updated = ? WHERE user_id = 'current-user'
